milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The acacia log pillar is a 3-block tall column at spawn-relative (3, 0-2, 0). Target is the middle block (3, 1, 0). Player must be within 16 blocks and facing it within 60 degrees to demonstrate they've visually located it. This is preferred over position_inside_box because finding means observing, not just being near.

Uses inventory_has because mining acacia_log drops the acacia_log item directly into the player's inventory (1:1 ratio, no silk touch needed). The player starts with 0 acacia_log in inventory (only brown_carpet x8 and wooden_axe), so having at least 1 acacia_log confirms successful mining. A wooden axe is provided for efficient mining (~1.5s per block).

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The 2x2 brown carpet patch is on the ground at spawn-relative (-3/-4, 0, 3/4). Target is the center of the cluster at (-3, 0, 3). Player must be within 16 blocks and facing it within 60 degrees. Note: player already has 8 brown_carpet in inventory, but the task is specifically to FIND the carpet patches placed in the world.

Uses count_in_box_at_least (kind='block') because decorating means physically placing blocks inside the cave. The cave interior spans approximately (7,0,-1) to (11,5,5) spawn-relative. Box is expanded to (5,0,-3)-(13,5,7) to generously encompass the full structure including entrance area. Checks for at least 2 brown_carpet blocks placed inside. The 4 pre-placed carpet blocks at (-3/-4, 0, 3/4) are far outside this box so no false positives. Player has 8 brown_carpet in inventory for this purpose.
